summary: Researched and validated current official Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Agent Skills discovery conventions; proposed the single-source AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md import arrangement, portable .agents skill layout, and duplicate-skill and Git-root caveats that materially informed the cross-platform agent handbook.
validationPerformed: Verified Codex AGENTS.md hierarchy and .agents/skills discovery against https://developers.openai.com/codex/guides/agents-md/ and https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills/.
Verified Claude Code CLAUDE.md importing AGENTS.md and project skill discovery against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills.

Verified OpenCode AGENTS.md precedence, .agents and .claude skill discovery, and permission.skill deny behavior against https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/, https://opencode.ai/docs/skills, https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions, and https://opencode.ai/config.json.
Verified portable SKILL.md naming, frontmatter, progressive disclosure, and relative file-reference conventions against https://agentskills.io/specification.

Locally resolved the proposed Claude adapter relative path to the canonical .agents skill and JSON-parsed the narrow OpenCode permission object; the OpenCode executable was unavailable, so runtime discovery was not exercised.

The record validator passed with four live records after this contribution was created; the enclosing make research-validate command then failed in an unrelated temporary-path normalization unit test because Python compared /private/var with /var.
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
This contribution was analysis and recommendation only; it did not author or edit the listed documentation files.
No live OpenCode or Claude Code discovery session was available, so host behavior was validated from primary documentation, the current OpenCode schema, and local syntax and path checks.
No Drop7 strategy theory, implementation, experiment, benchmark, or scientific result is attributed to this contribution.
